description: Scoring schema for automated keyword-based evaluation. All scoring is mechanical — no interpretation.

fields.run_id: UUID string. Primary key per run.
fields.timestamp_utc: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of API call completion.
fields.model_id: Model identifier as in models config.
fields.task_id: Task identifier as in tasks config.
fields.prompt_tokens: Integer. Token count reported by API for prompt.
fields.completion_tokens: Integer. Token count reported by API for completion.
fields.latency_ms: Integer. Wall-clock ms from request send to response received.
fields.http_status: Integer. HTTP status code returned by API.
fields.response_text: String. Raw completion text, stripped of leading/trailing whitespace.
fields.keyword_hits: List of strings. Which expected_keywords were found (substring match, case-sensitive).
fields.keyword_score: Float. keyword_hit_count / keyword_total if keyword_total > 0, else null.
fields.response_line_count: Integer. Number of non-empty lines in response_text.
fields.error: null if success. String error type if failed (see error_types).
fields.error_detail: null if success. String with exception message or HTTP body on failure.
fields.dry_run: Boolean. True if --dry-run flag was set.

notes: keyword_score is null for tasks where expected_keywords is empty (e.g., t03, t08).
Scoring fields are populated by dataset_writer.py at write time.
No model comparison or ranking is derived from this schema — raw data only.
